_about: Everything visitors read on the public page, and its sign, with the wording it starts with. You change them on the Public page tab, under Words. {name}-style parts are filled in as the page runs.

words.label: When nothing's playing
words.text: Nothing's on right now. Pick a show to start it.

words.label: Button to install the page as an app (where the phone offers it)
During a rest break
words.text: The lights are resting for a few minutes, for the neighbours. Picks waiting start after.

words.label: When a show's playing and others are waiting
Their own pick in the queue
When others in the queue start
Under the heading
words.text: It plays on the lights and speaker here. If something's on, yours plays next.

words.label: Heading when visitors can't start one yet
On a show that's in the queue
Button on a show that's already waiting
Button on the show that's on now
Button on a show that played a few minutes ago
Button on a show too long to finish before closing
Button when something's on (adds to the queue)
When there's nothing to pick
words.text: There aren't any shows to pick yet.

words.label: When nothing can be picked yet
Theirs is further back
words.text: You're {place} in the queue, starting in about {minutes}.

words.label: They've already got one waiting
words.text: You can pick another show once yours starts.

words.label: They've got the most waiting
words.text: You've got {count} shows waiting, the most for one phone.

words.label: The queue is full
words.text: The queue is full. Try again in a few minutes.

words.label: A show that's just been taken off
words.text: That show isn't available any more.

words.label: Picking a show that's already waiting
words.text: That one's already in the queue. Pick another!

words.label: Picking the show that's on now
words.text: That one's playing now. Pick another!

words.label: Picking a show that played a few minutes ago
words.text: That one played a few minutes ago. Pick another, or try it again in {minutes}.

words.label: Picking again too soon after their own show
words.text: Thanks for picking! You can pick again in {minutes}.

words.label: A pick that wouldn't finish before closing time
words.text: That one wouldn't finish before we close at {time}. Pick a shorter one?

groups.group: Voting (when visitors vote for what's next)

words.label: When nothing's playing
words.text: Nothing's on right now. Vote for a show to start it.

words.label: When a show's playing
words.text: On now: {name} · vote for what's next

words.label: Under the heading
words.text: The show with the most votes plays next. You get one vote, and can change it until then.

words.label: Button on the show you voted for (press to take it back)
How many votes a show has
When the hours never come round
words.text: We're not open at the moment. Come back another time!

words.label: While checking where they are
words.text: Checking you're by the lights… Your phone may ask to share your location. It's only used for this and isn't kept.

words.label: Too far away
words.text: You're too far away to start a show. Come and see the lights!

words.label: They won't share their location
words.text: To start a show, let this page use your location: it's only used to check you're by the lights. Allow it in your browser's settings, then press Try again.

words.label: Their phone takes too long
words.text: Your phone took too long to find where you are.

words.label: Their phone can't tell
words.text: Your phone couldn't tell where you are.

words.label: No location sent
words.text: Turn on location so we can check you're by the lights.

words.label: No home location to measure from
words.text: Shows can't be started from here right now. Ask at the house.

words.label: The warning
words.text: ⚠ The shows have flashing lights, which may affect people with photosensitive epilepsy.

words.label: Under the button
words.text: Hear the music on your phone, in time with the lights.

words.label: Stop button
words.text: Turn the music off on this phone (the lights carry on)

words.label: Small Listen button at the top
Small button while listening (press to turn the phone's sound off)
On a show with no speaker (Start also starts listening)
While listening (the card already shows what's on; {name} adds its name)
Listening, with nothing playing
words.text: Listening. The music starts here when a show does.

words.label: When the phone needs a press to play
words.text: Press Listen again to hear the music.

words.label: Tip while listening
words.text: Keep this page open. On some phones the music stops when the screen locks.

words.label: Music ahead / behind: tip
words.text: If you hear the beat after the lights flash, press Earlier. Bluetooth headphones usually need it.

words.label: Wrong PIN
words.text: That PIN isn't right. Try again.

words.label: Too many wrong PINs
words.text: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in 10 minutes.

words.label: Listening switched off
words.text: Listening on your phone isn't on right now.

words.label: Pass ran out
words.text: Press Listen again to carry on listening.

words.label: Under that
words.text: Come back later to start one.

words.label: Opened without the code
words.text: Scan the code on the sign to start a show.

words.label: Under that
words.text: This page only works from the link in the code.

words.label: Asking outside the hours
words.text: Shows can't be started right now. Come back when we're open.

words.label: Lots of people at once
words.text: Lots of people are asking right now. Try again in a minute.

words.label: The page can't reach the lights
words.text: Can't reach the lights right now. Trying again…

words.label: Under the title
words.text: Scan to start a light show
